subject: Future Tech
title: Targeted Drug Delivery
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Targeted Drug Delivery.

hook.text: Chemotherapy poisons the whole body to kill cancer.

buildup.text: Traditional drugs flood the bloodstream. Only a fraction reaches the target.

discovery.text: Nano-carriers are engineered to recognize cancer cells.

twist.text: The first nano-drug, Doxil, was approved in 1995. It wraps chemo in a lipid nanoshell, reducing heart damage by 50%.

climax.text: Dozens of nanomedicines are now approved.

punchline.text: Tiny carriers. Precise delivery. Medicine that aims.

quiz.question: How did COVID mRNA vaccines use nanotechnology?
options: mRNA was wrapped in lipid nanoparticles for delivery
They contained quantum dots for tracking
